answer: Skipped rounds should cost interest. Each identity carries coverage debt: every epoch without an answered challenge adds one unit, and future payouts dilute by one over one plus debt squared. A key stranded on its island of skipped rounds gets its zenith years taxed through the vault funding them, while consecutive answers burn the debt down. A farm of a thousand half-maintained keys accumulates debt across all of them — dilution outpaces spread earnings. Daily participation is the only amortization: the discount rate punishes abandonment, no slashing or jury needed.
